title: AWS SNS connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One SNS connector instance's settings, read by the native cloud family (`loams_connector_cloud::sns`, CN2 Task 19): the topic the sink publishes to (PublishBatch). The `auth.*` keys hold the **names** of secrets (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list. See docs/guides/connectors/aws-sns.md.

topic_arn.description: The topic's ARN, standard or FIFO.

region.description: The AWS region, such as eu-west-1. Required unless `endpoint` is set; with an emulator endpoint it defaults to us-east-1.

endpoint.description: An emulator or VPC endpoint URL, such as floci's http://floci:4566. With an emulator endpoint and no `auth`, requests are signed with a placeholder key (R19.3).

auth.description: Static AWS credentials, each the **name** of a secret (the manifest's `iam` auth slug: SigV4). Required without `endpoint`. There is no IMDS, IRSA or SSO chain yet (R19.1).

access_key_id.description: The name of the secret holding the AWS access key id. Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance.

secret_access_key.description: The name of the secret holding the AWS secret access key. Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance.

session_token.description: The name of the secret holding an AWS session token, for temporary credentials. Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance.

message_group_id.description: FIFO topics only: the message group id; without it the event's subject.
